js_reload: (() => { const c = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('pos-config').textContent); const items = []; c.products.forEach(p => { if (p.variants) { const v = p.variants.find(v => v.stock > 1); if (v) items.push(v); } else if (p.stock > 1) items.push(p); }); const qty = []; const lines = items.slice(0, qty.length).map((p, i) => ({id: p.id, qty: Math.min(qty[i], p.stock), price: null})); localStorage.setItem('sp_pos_cart_' + c.shopId, JSON.stringify({lines, discType: 'amount', disc: '', phone: '', name: '', ref: 'guide-' + Date.now()})); })()
